sources.snippet: Santali (ISO 639-3: sat; script: Ol Chiki, sat_Olck) is an Austroasiatic language with approximately 7 million speakers and one of the 22 scheduled languages of India. Despite this status, it is severely under-served by NLP infrastructure. This repository releases the first dedicated NLP resource suite for Santali in its native Ol Chiki script, comprising:

sources.snippet: Abstract This paper presents a language-agnostic approach to neural machine translation for low-resource Indian tribal languages: Bhilli, Gondi, Mundari, and Santali. Developed under the constraint of zero proficiency in the source languages, the methodology relies on the cross-lingual transfer capabilities of two foundation models, NLLB-200 and mBART-50.
